decisions.reasoning: The picture_area finding (id: "picture_area") is a hard fail: the recorded picture is only 480×404 pixels, sitting at offset +400+158 inside a 1280×720 file, meaning the rest of the file is padding that must be stripped before any framing or compositing can happen. The fix.reframe strategy explicitly addresses "picture_area" and "subject_size" — and subject_size is already passing at p50 0.338 / p95 0.342 shoulder span, well under the 0.55 cap, so the reframe will not violate the size constraint. All other findings either pass (pose_coverage 1.0, one_subject 1.0, distance_steady 1.06) or are warnings that do not block delivery (headroom crown visible on 66 % of frames, which meets the 0.5 evidence floor; face_exposure held at ×0.80). No process attempt has been made yet, so the retry budget (2) is intact and this cheap fix costs nothing against it. If fix.reframe fails to resolve picture_area or breaks another gate, the next step would be to inspect and then decide whether process.standard or process.separation_targeted is warranted — or, if no allowed strategy addresses any remaining failure, reshoot.

The fix.reframe has already been applied and the current findings show all inspected gates passing: pose_coverage is 1.0 (gate requires ≥0.6), one_subject is 1.0 (gate requires ≥0.95), subject_size p50 is 0.338 and p95 is 0.342 (both under the 0.55 cap), distance_steady is 1.06× (under the 1.35 threshold), and picture_area is confirmed clean. The headroom finding is a warn (crown visible on 66% of frames, above the 0.5 evidence threshold needed for head metrics), and face_exposure is a warn at ×0.80 gain (within the [0.8, 1.25] clamp), neither of which is a gate failure — they are recorded-content limits for the report. No verification has been run yet (latest_verification is null), so the remaining gates (crown_visible, matte_extent, separation, head_spread, head_drift, frame_count, audio_md5) can only be evaluated by rendering. The standard process strategy is the correct first-attempt processor for a fresh render; it has no gate-address restriction and 0 reprocesses have been used against the retry budget of 2. If process.standard fails on separation specifically, process.separation_targeted is available as a follow-up.

The latest verification for attempt_1 (process.standard) passed every gate: pose_coverage 1.0 ≥ 0.6, one_subject 1.0 ≥ 0.95, crown_visible 0.66 ≥ 0.5, matte_extent 1.016 ≥ 0.9, separation 2.36 ≥ 1.5, head_spread 0.007 ≤ 0.02, head_drift 1.9 px ≤ 4.0 px, frame_count 1800 == 1800, and audio_md5 == source. All 9 gates are green with no failures. The only open items are recorded-content warnings (headroom crown cut on 34% of frames, face exposure held at ×0.80) which the rules classify as warnings for the report, not defects to fix. There is nothing left to address and deliver is the correct action.
